description: This file defines types, utility functions, and exports related to legacy configuration rules, migrations, and data transformation functions within a software project. It includes functions for handling records, merging, validating, and transforming legacy config data structures, as well as utilities to manage agent configurations.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a record from a value if it is a valid record, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: ensureRecord
methods.description: Ensures a record exists at a given key within a root record; creates it if absent.

methods.name: mergeMissing
methods.description: Recursively merges entries from source into target, skipping undefined or blocked keys.

methods.name: mapLegacyAudioTranscription
methods.description: Transforms a value into a structured command object if it matches expected legacy audio transcription format.

methods.name: getAgentsList
methods.description: Extracts the list of agents from an agents record.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentIdFromRaw
methods.description: Resolves the default agent ID from raw configuration, based on priority order.

methods.name: ensureAgentEntry
methods.description: Ensures an agent entry with a specific ID exists in the list, creating it if needed.

methods.name: defineLegacyConfigMigration
methods.description: Defines or returns a legacy configuration migration specification.
